general.siteFullName: Emad Toranji Resume | Full-Stack Web Developer

home.summary-text: Full-Stack Web Developer with over 7 years of continuous hands-on experience in architecting, engineering, and deploying scalable web applications and cloud platforms. Specializing in modern web technologies across the Next.js and React ecosystem with App Router, React Server Components (RSC/SSR), and modular UI design using Tailwind CSS. Experienced in building high-throughput RESTful APIs and real-time WebSocket services with Node.js and PHP, modeling and optimizing relational database schemas (PostgreSQL / MySQL), implementing secure authentication pipelines and RBAC with Next-Auth and JWT, and engineering interactive Telegram Mini Apps (TMA) integrated with online payment systems.
experience-items: Architected and delivered end-to-end web applications with Next.js and React, leveraging React Server Components, Static Site Generation (SSG/ISR), and structured search engine optimization (JSON-LD).
Engineered component-based design systems and responsive user interfaces with Tailwind CSS, adhering to accessibility standards (WCAG) and smooth UI micro-interactions.
Implemented end-to-end authentication and role-based access control (RBAC) pipelines, CSRF mitigations, and secure session management using Next-Auth, encrypted JWTs, and HttpOnly cookies.
Developed high-performance Telegram Mini Apps (TMA) featuring real-time API integrations, online payment gateways, Telegram authentication protocols, and subscription management.
Modeled, normalized, and optimized relational database schemas (PostgreSQL and MySQL), including query profiling, indexing strategies, and transactional data integrity.
Built operational admin dashboards and internationalized (i18n) reporting systems featuring dynamic data visualization and structured export pipelines.
